name: 1488 Crossing
summary: 1488 Crossing is a recently renovated 40,000 square foot shopping center located at FM 1488 and I-45 South in Conroe's rapidly developing North Houston corridor. Owned by Davis Holdings since 1945, the property is strategically positioned in the path of growth with major residential, office, and medical projects transforming the surrounding area into a valuable infill location.
demographics: 1488 Crossing serves the rapidly growing North Houston corridor in Conroe, attracting a diverse mix of families and professionals from surrounding residential developments. The trade area is experiencing significant growth with new office, residential, retail, and medical projects under development, indicating an evolving demographic profile with increasing household incomes. Primary visitors include commuters along FM 1488, one of the few major East/West thoroughfares in the region, as well as residents from nearby subdivisions seeking convenient shopping and services. The center's location at the intersection of FM 1488 and I-45 South positions it to capture both local neighborhood traffic and pass-by customers from the interstate corridor.
description: 1488 Crossing is a 40,000 square foot renovated shopping center strategically positioned at the southwest quadrant of FM 1488 and Interstate 45 South in Conroe, Texas. Developed and operated by Davis Holdings, a family-owned company with a distinguished track record in real estate since 1945, this property sits directly in the path of North Houston's explosive growth. The center benefits from its location on FM 1488, one of the few major East-West thoroughfares serving the region, providing excellent visibility and accessibility for both local residents and interstate travelers. As the surrounding area continues to transform with major office, residential, retail, and medical developments currently underway, 1488 Crossing is transitioning from a suburban location to what will soon be considered a valuable infill property. The recent renovations have modernized the center to meet the needs of today's retailers and shoppers, while Davis Holdings' experienced management team ensures the property maintains high occupancy and continues to attract quality tenants. With strong traffic counts, strategic positioning, and the backing of a proven real estate operator, 1488 Crossing represents a well-positioned neighborhood shopping destination poised for long-term appreciation as the North Houston market matures around it.
